title: NECO Financial Accounting Part 1: Foundations, Final Accounts & Records - Financial Accounting - Meaning and uses of control accounts
exam: NECO Financial Accounting Part 1: Foundations, Final Accounts & Records
subject: Financial Accounting
topic: Meaning and uses of control accounts

questions.q: The following are primary purposes of preparing a control account EXCEPT to
options: Provide a quick total of debtors or creditors for the preparation of final accounts
Localize errors to specific ledgers, making them easier to find
Prevent fraud by ensuring the work of one clerk is checked against another's
Calculate the exact gross profit realized from the firm's trading activities
questions.explain:
A **Control Account** (or Total Account) is a summary account that checks the arithmetical accuracy of the individual subsidiary ledgers. Its primary uses are locating errors (by checking totals against individual balances), deterring fraud, and quickly ascertaining the total debtors/creditors. 

Calculating gross profit is the function of the **Trading Account**, not a control account.
